aggregate_datadog_ci_pipeline_events.description: Aggregates CI pipeline events to produce statistics, metrics, and grouped analytics.

aggregate_datadog_test_events.description: Aggregates Datadog Test Optimization events to quantify reliability and performance trends with aggregation functions, optional metrics, group-by facets, and configurable test levels.

aggregate_dora_deployments.description: Returns DORA metrics (deployment frequency, change lead time, change failure rate, recovery time) for a service, team, or repo, as scalar values or timeseries.

aggregate_product_analytics_events.description: Aggregates Product Analytics event data as a scalar or timeseries, supporting count, cardinality, average, sum, min, max, and percentile calculations with optional grouping.

aggregate_rum_events.description: Aggregates RUM events to compute counts, sums, averages, min, max, cardinality, and percentiles, with grouping support.

aggregate_spans.description: Aggregates APM spans to compute counts, sums, averages, minimums, maximums, cardinality, and percentiles (p50 to p99).

analyse_datadog_k8s_rollout.description: Assembles a [Kubernetes](https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/monitoring/kubernetes_explorer.md) Deployment rollout in one call: rollout status and progress, timing (ETA while the rollout is in progress, duration after it finishes), the new, previous, and old ReplicaSet split by revision, and before/after impact series (RED, resource utilization, and log counts).

analyze_cloud_network_monitoring.description: Investigates network-level issues using [Cloud Network Monitoring](https://docs.datadoghq.com/network_monitoring/cloud_network_monitoring.md) data, analyzing network flow data to detect anomalies like elevated retransmission rates.

analyze_datadog_error_tracking_errors.description: Analyzes Datadog Error Tracking errors using SQL queries for counting, aggregations, and numerical analysis.

analyze_datadog_logs.description: Analyze Datadog logs using SQL queries for counting, aggregations, and numerical analysis.

analyze_datadog_security_findings.description: Primary tool for analyzing security findings using SQL queries.

analyze_datadog_security_signals.description: Analyzes security signals using SQL queries for aggregations, grouping, and trend analysis.

apm_discover_span_tags.description: Discovers available tag keys on spans within a time range.

apm_get_primary_tag_keys.description: Retrieves the primary tag keys configured for the organization.

apm_get_recommendation.description: Retrieves full details of a specific APM recommendation by ID.

apm_get_service_health.description: Retrieves the current health status (ok/warning/critical) for one or more APM services plus the signals driving it (paging monitors, incidents, Watchdog anomalies, DBM regressions).

apm_latency_bottleneck_summary.description: Analyzes latency bottlenecks across traces in an anomaly period using self-time calculations.

apm_query_trace.description: Runs a read-only SQL query against a trace's spans to answer a specific question, such as ranking spans by self-time or isolating one span's attributes.

apm_search_recommendations.description: Searches for APM recommendations from Datadog.

ask_widget_expert.description: Ask a Datadog widget expert a question about widget configuration, schemas, query syntax, field usage, debugging, or pitfalls.

build_audit_trail_query.description: Translates a natural-language description into an Audit Trail query string.

check_datadog_flag_implementation.description: Checks if a feature flag is implemented in code.

cost_recommendations.description: Lists an organization's Cloud Cost Management cost-saving recommendations, ranked by estimated potential daily savings (highest first).

ddsql_create_link.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Generates a Datadog UI link to the [DDSQL Editor](https://docs.datadoghq.com/ddsql_editor.md) with a given query pre-populated.

ddsql_get_spec.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Gets a compact DDSQL capability spec, including supported SQL functions, SQL keywords, and DDSQL-specific differences from standard PostgreSQL.

ddsql_read_saved_query.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Gets a saved DDSQL query by its query ID, including its name, SQL text, columns, description, and author metadata.

ddsql_run_query.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Runs a DDSQL query and returns results.

ddsql_schema_get_table_columns.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Gets static SQL columns for a DDSQL table from schema metadata.

ddsql_schema_search_tables.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Searches DDSQL datasets and returns tables (public data sources and reference tables) and available metrics.

ddsql_schema_search_unstructured_fields.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Searches and ranks fields for unstructured DDSQL sources, such as logs, RUM, and spans, sorted by frequency.

ddsql_search_saved_queries.description: *Toolset: **ddsql*** Searches saved DDSQL queries by name or description and returns their SQL text and metadata, sorted by most recently modified.

describe_datadog_k8s_resource.description: Gets detailed information about a specific [Kubernetes](https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/monitoring/kubernetes_explorer.md) resource, including resource-specific details such as CPU and memory requests and limits, and optionally tags, labels, annotations, manifest history, parent resources, and a deep link to the [Kubernetes Explorer](https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/monitoring/kubernetes_explorer.md).

describe_observability_pipeline.description: Retrieves the full configuration of a pipeline by ID: its sources, processors, and destinations, and how they connect.

diagnose_experiment_run_failure.description: Diagnoses why the latest (or a specific) analysis pipeline run for an experiment failed.

discover_datadog_logpoint.description: Discovers the deployment environments where a service runs [Live Debugger](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/live_debugger.md) and the features it supports, such as `message_templates`, `conditions`, and `capture_expressions`.

estimate_datadog_metric_cardinality.description: Estimates a metric's timeseries cardinality for a proposed allowlist of tag keys.

explore_experiment_results.description: Segments results by an assignment property (device type, country, plan tier, and so on) or over time.

explore_profiling_call_graph.description: Returns a call-graph view (caller-to-callee edges) of hot functions for a given profile type.

explore_profiling_flame_graph.description: Returns top-N stack traces by value contribution for a given profile type.

explore_profiling_timeline.description: Returns a timeline of lane groups (threads, garbage collection, and so on) with CPU and I/O activity.

find_datadog_database_instances.description: Discovers and ranks database instances for DBM investigation.

find_new_jumps.description: Detects sudden changes in an APM timeseries for latency, error rate, or throughput.

forecast_timeseries.description: Forecasts future values from supplied historical timestamps and values, with optional confidence bounds.

get_assistant_conversation_history.description: Retrieves the full conversation history for a specific assistant conversation by its ID.

get_autonomous_system_status.description: Checks the health of an Autonomous System (AS) using [Network Path](https://docs.datadoghq.com/network_monitoring/network_path.md) data, comparing latency, packet loss, and visibility against a 7-day baseline.

get_bits_ai_investigation.description: Retrieves the status, findings, and conclusions of a Bits AI investigation.

get_change_stories.description: Retrieves tracked change events for an APM service over a time range.

get_cloud_resource_details.description: Gets the configuration and metadata that Datadog records for a single cloud resource.

get_data_catalog_schema.description: Returns the entity type schema for every platform with data in the catalog: entity types, containment hierarchy, filterable attributes, and default metrics.

get_data_entity_details.description: Fetches full details and attributes (owner, tags, custom attributes, platform, schema, database, account) for one or more data entities by ID.

get_data_entity_hierarchy.description: Fetches the containment hierarchy (ancestors and descendants) for one or more entities — for example, which database or schema a table belongs to, or which tables are in a schema.

get_data_entity_lineage.description: Fetches the live reachable lineage subgraph (nodes and edges) from one or more anchor entities, upstream, downstream, or both.

get_data_observability_monitor.description: Retrieves data quality metric timeseries for a given monitor ID, including anomaly-detection bounds when enabled.

get_data_observability_monitor_coverage.description: Fetches all data quality monitors for the org and resolves each monitor's filter to the entities it covers.

get_data_observability_monitor_group_sta.description: Queries the current alert and warn state of data quality monitor groups.

get_data_observability_recommendation.description: Retrieves full details of a specific Data Observability recommendation by ID, including its structured body describing the problem, evidence, and proposed change.

get_datadog_bits_agent.description: Retrieves an agent by ID, including its system prompt, action tools, MCP servers, and the workflows that invoke it.

get_datadog_bits_agent_conversation_even.description: Retrieves a conversation's event history using its `agent_id` and `conversation_id`, including prompts, agent messages, tool calls, tool results, and errors.

get_datadog_case.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific work item (case) by ID or key, including title, status, priority, assignee, and timestamps.

get_datadog_case_attachment.description: Lists the attachments on a work item (case), or retrieves the contents of a specific attachment by ID.

get_datadog_case_links.description: Lists all links for a work item (case), including each link's ID, relationship type, and the work items on each side.

get_datadog_case_project.description: Retrieves details for a specific project by ID.

get_datadog_code_coverage_branch_summary.description: Fetches aggregated code coverage summary metrics for a repository branch, including total coverage, patch coverage, and service/codeowner breakdowns.

get_datadog_code_coverage_commit_summary.description: Fetches aggregated code coverage summary metrics for a repository commit, including total coverage, patch coverage, and service/codeowner breakdowns.

get_datadog_code_coverage_files.description: Fetches per-file code coverage line data for a repository commit, branch, or pull request.

get_datadog_code_coverage_pr_summary.description: Fetches aggregated code coverage summary metrics for a pull request, including total coverage, patch coverage, and service or codeowner breakdowns.

get_datadog_dashboard.description: Retrieves a Datadog [dashboard](https://docs.datadoghq.com/dashboards.md) by ID, returning its title, description, tags, and widgets.

get_datadog_database_calling_services.description: Identifies upstream APM services and resources that call database queries.

get_datadog_database_explain_plans.description: Retrieves PostgreSQL explain plans for a query signature within a time frame.

get_datadog_database_health_signals.description: Runs health checks to surface potential PostgreSQL issues such as CPU saturation, restarts, query latency, and blocking.

get_datadog_database_instance_settings.description: Retrieves collected PostgreSQL configuration settings for a Database Monitoring instance, the same values shown on the Configuration tab.

get_datadog_database_query_performance.description: Analyzes a specific PostgreSQL query's performance.

get_datadog_database_query_statement.description: Retrieves the SQL statement text for a given query signature.

get_datadog_database_recommendations.description: Retrieves live database recommendations for a database, query, table, host, or index.

get_datadog_database_schemas.description: Fetches schema definitions (columns, indexes, foreign keys, partitions) for one or more database objects.

get_datadog_debugger_snapshot.description: Retrieves captured variables from a [Live Debugger](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/live_debugger.md) snapshot.

get_datadog_deployment_gate.description: Gets a configured Deployment Gate by its gate ID, including its rules and settings.

get_datadog_deployment_gate_evaluation.description: Gets a Deployment Gate evaluation with the result of each rule.

get_datadog_error_tracking_analytics.description: Retrieves daily Error Tracking Issue counts broken down by state and category, for a set of services or teams.

get_datadog_error_tracking_issue.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Error Tracking Issue from Datadog.

get_datadog_feature_flag.description: Retrieves details about a specific feature flag.

get_datadog_flaky_tests.description: Searches Datadog [Test Optimization](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tests.md) for flaky tests and returns triage details (failure rate, category, owners, history, CI impact), with pagination and sorting.

get_datadog_flaky_tests_management_polic.description: Retrieves the Flaky Tests Management policies configured for a repository, including auto-quarantine windows, branch rules, failure rate thresholds, disable policies, and retry settings.

get_datadog_form.description: Retrieves a form's full metadata and definition by ID.

get_datadog_incident.description: Retrieves detailed information about an incident.

get_datadog_k8s_manifest.description: Retrieves the YAML manifest for a specific [Kubernetes](https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/monitoring/kubernetes_explorer.md) resource.

get_datadog_metric.description: Queries and analyzes historical or real-time metric data, supporting custom queries and aggregations.

get_datadog_metric_context.description: Retrieves detailed information about a metric including metadata, available tags, and tag values for filtering and grouping.

get_datadog_monitor_templates.description: Retrieves available monitor templates to help you create monitors.

get_datadog_notebook.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific notebook by ID, including name, status, and author.

get_datadog_security_aap_blocking_config.description: Retrieves the organization-wide AAP blocking and denylist enforcement settings.

get_datadog_security_aap_custom_rules.description: Retrieves one App & API Protection (AAP) custom WAF rule by ID or lists custom rules.

get_datadog_security_aap_denylist.description: Lists blocked IPs, users, and user agents (denylist entries), with optional filtering.

get_datadog_security_detection_rules_sch.description: Returns the authoring reference and schema for detection rules.

get_datadog_security_findings_schema.description: Returns the schema (available fields and their types) for security findings.

get_datadog_security_findings_ticket_sug.description: Returns ranked project suggestions for ticketing security findings.

get_datadog_security_iac_custom_rules.description: Retrieves one Infrastructure as Code (IaC) [custom rule](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/code_security/iac_security/custom_rules.md) by ID or lists the custom rules in your organization.

get_datadog_security_iac_custom_rules_sc.description: Returns the schema for IaC custom rules: allowed platforms, categories, severities, the rule ID format, and the fields each write tool accepts.

get_datadog_security_ioc_indicator.description: Retrieve full detail for one [IoC Explorer](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/triage_and_investigate/ioc_explorer.md) indicator by value (score, category, AS info, GeoIP, log sources, signal counts).

get_datadog_security_ioc_schema.description: Discover filterable fields and their values for [IoC Explorer](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/triage_and_investigate/ioc_explorer.md).

get_datadog_security_signal.description: Retrieves the full details of a single security signal by ID, including attributes, rule information, triage state, tags, and case correlations.

get_datadog_security_signals_schema.description: Returns the available fields and their types for security signals.

get_datadog_security_trace_passlist.description: Returns all WAF exclusion filter (passlist) entries for the organization to review existing suppressions.

get_datadog_spreadsheet.description: Retrieves a Datadog spreadsheet by ID.

get_datadog_spreadsheet_reference.description: Returns reference documentation for building inputs to `upsert_datadog_spreadsheet`.

get_datadog_spreadsheet_tab_data.description: Retrieves paginated data from a table, sheet, or legacy pivot tab in a Datadog spreadsheet.

get_datadog_test_optimization_settings.description: Retrieves the Test Optimization features that are enabled for a service, including Test Impact Analysis (ITR), Early Flake Detection (EFD), Auto Test Retries (ATR), Failed Test Replay, Code Coverage collection, and PR Comments.

get_datadog_trace.description: Fetches a complete trace from Datadog APM using a trace ID.

get_datadog_workflow.description: Retrieves a workflow by ID, including its metadata and complete specification.

get_datadog_workflow_action.description: Retrieves the definition of a Workflow Automation action by action ID.

get_datadog_workflow_instance.description: Retrieves a lightweight summary of a workflow execution instance, with an option to include the detailed execution record.

get_datadog_workflow_spec_schema.description: Retrieves the JSON schema for a complete Workflow Automation specification, including the structure required for triggers, steps, and connections.

get_datadog_workflow_step_data.description: Retrieves execution data for one workflow step, with optional execution context.

get_entity_descriptions.description: Gets custom user-defined descriptions on data entities.

get_entity_tags.description: Gets custom user-defined tags on data entities.

get_experiment.description: Gets a single experiment by ID, including status, linked feature flag, subject type, primary metric, assignment dates, and decision.

get_experiment_diagnostics.description: Returns a health summary for an experiment before interpreting results: sample ratio mismatch (SRM) status, total subjects, per-variant exposure counts and fractions, and per-metric health including unreliable and zero-data metrics.

get_experiment_segmentation_property_val.description: Returns the concrete values for a segmentation property (for example, `["mobile", "desktop", "tablet"]` for device type).

get_external_provider_status.description: Retrieves external provider outages, including their status and impacted regions.

get_form_definition_schema.description: Returns the JSON schema used to validate a form's field and layout definitions.

get_form_responses.description: Reads submitted responses from the data store linked to a form.

get_governance_control.description: Retrieves details for a governance [control](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/governance_console/controls.md) by detection type, including its configuration, detection parameters, available mitigations, notification settings, and detection counts.

get_governance_detection.description: Retrieves details for a governance detection, including its state, resource details, assignment, mitigation deadline, and notification history.

get_influential_tags.description: Identifies tag dimensions associated with a spike, drop, or other change in a metric.

get_investigations_from_incident_id.description: Retrieves Bits AI investigations linked to a specific Datadog incident.

get_metric_cardinality_profile.description: Identifies the tag-level drivers of a metric's indexed timeseries volume, including tag cardinality, query activity from the past 30 days, active aggregations, and the direct tag configuration.

get_metric_definition.description: Returns the definition of an experiment metric — the underlying event query, data source, and the recommended Datadog MCP tool for investigating why the metric moved.

get_metric_governance_status.description: Retrieves the Metrics without Limits™ governance status for up to 20 metrics, including direct tag configurations, exemptions, and optionally the first matching tag indexing rule.

get_metric_tag_configuration.description: Retrieves the direct Metrics without Limits™ tag configuration for up to 20 metrics.

get_metric_tags.description: Retrieves indexed and ingested tag keys for a metric over the last four hours, with one observed sample value for each key.

get_metric_volume.description: Retrieves series volume for up to 20 metrics.

get_monitor_coverage.description: Finds monitoring gaps and coverage for services or hosts.

get_ndm_device.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific network device by its device ID.

get_network_path_test_runs.description: Searches and retrieves [Network Path](https://docs.datadoghq.com/network_monitoring/network_path.md) test runs with hop-by-hop traceroute data, including a link to the path in the Network Path view.

get_observability_pipeline_component_sch.description: Without arguments, returns the available source, processor, and destination types.

get_popular_warehouse_tables_by_query_fr.description: Ranks tables by query activity, grouped by who's querying them: human users, BI tools, orchestrators, ETL tools, or internal service accounts.

get_product_analytics_saved_chart.description: Retrieves the full definition of a saved Product Analytics chart by ID, including its query parameters, filters, and time interval.

get_profiling_field_values.description: Returns values for a specific frame or context field discovered with `get_profiling_fields`.

get_profiling_fields.description: Discovers frame and context facet fields (such as `@stack.function` and `@labels.trace_endpoint`) usable in `get_profiling_timeseries` groupBy and filter parameters.

get_profiling_profile_types.description: Returns available profile types and families for a given query context (query string and time range) or a trace/span context.

get_profiling_runtime_ids.description: Returns individual profiled runtime IDs (processes or containers) in scope.

get_profiling_service_insights.description: Returns pre-computed service insights, including a high-level summary, contextual signals (affected methods, packages, processes), and recommended next steps.

get_profiling_services.description: Lists profiled services and their profiling families in scope.

get_profiling_tag_names.description: Discovers available tag names (such as service, host, env, version, family, runtime-id, kube_*) for filtering profiling data.

get_profiling_tag_values.description: Returns values for a specific profiling tag (for example, all values of the service tag).

get_profiling_timeseries.description: Returns profiling data aggregated as timeseries (rate metrics).

get_reference_table_rows.description: *Toolset: **reference-tables*** Retrieves specific rows from a reference table by their primary key values.

get_replay_summary.description: Generates an AI-powered, time-based play-by-play of what a user did during a specific session replay—pages visited, actions taken, and key moments—organized into chapters.

get_rum_insight.description: Returns aggregated insights for RUM Views: waterfall, long tasks, vital distributions, and tag analysis.

get_rum_operation_insights.description: Investigates why an operation is failing, slow, or abandoned.

get_rum_operation_summary.description: Returns a health summary for a single operation: volume, success rate, failure breakdown by reason, latency percentiles, a per-bucket success and failure trend, and related SLOs and monitors.

get_rum_summary.description: Returns a summary of vital metrics for a RUM application, with period-over-period diffs.

get_rum_view_waterfall.description: Reconstructs the chronological load timeline for a single RUM view occurrence on web or mobile.

get_spark_job_health.description: Retrieves detailed health metrics (duration, executor CPU time, shuffle, spill, worst stages) for a single Spark or Databricks job run.

get_spark_sql_plan.description: Retrieves the Spark SQL physical execution plan for a stage, including join strategies, shuffle information, and per-node metrics.

get_synthetics_tests.description: Searches Datadog Synthetic HTTP API tests.

get_tag_indexing_rules.description: Lists Metrics without Limits™ tag indexing rules in priority order.

get_tag_rule.description: Retrieves a tag rule by ID, including the tag key it governs, its allowed value patterns, its scope, and whether it is enabled.

get_warehouse_query_history.description: Fetches recent queries that touched specific entities, in reverse chronological order, including the SQL text, execution state, and query type.

get_watchdog_story.description: Retrieves a Watchdog story by its key, including insight details, the timeline, and available root cause analysis.

get_widget.description: Retrieves and visualizes Datadog metrics, traces, logs, and other data as interactive charts.

get_widget_reference.description: Returns schemas and building instructions for dashboard widget types.

list_assistant_conversations.description: Lists all Datadog Assistant conversations for the current user.

list_audit_events.description: Lists Audit Trail events over a time window with support for pagination and an optional query.

list_autonomous_system_statuses.description: Lists degraded Autonomous Systems (ASes) using [Network Path](https://docs.datadoghq.com/network_monitoring/network_path.md) data, without requiring a specific AS number.

list_data_observability_recommendations.description: Lists cost and performance optimization recommendations for data jobs and queries (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery), with estimated cost and duration savings.

list_datadog_bits_agent_conversations.description: Lists an agent's past conversations, including IDs and titles.

list_datadog_bits_agent_mcp_tools.description: Lists the tools exposed by the `datadog` or `code-sandbox` MCP server for a specific agent.

list_datadog_bits_agent_models.description: Lists supported model identifiers, identifies the default, and notes capabilities such as tool search support.

list_datadog_bits_agents.description: Lists the custom AI agents in your organization, including each agent's ID, name, description, and model.

list_datadog_case_projects.description: Lists available [Work Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/service_management/case_management.md) projects with optional filtering by name or key.

list_datadog_feature_flag_allocations.description: Lists allocations for a feature flag in a specific environment.

list_datadog_feature_flag_environments.description: Lists environments configured for feature flags.

list_datadog_feature_flags.description: Lists feature flags with pagination support.

list_datadog_security_findings_automatio.description: Lists security findings automation rules of a given type (`mute`, `due_date`, `ticket_creation`, or `severity_modifier`).

list_datadog_session_logpoints.description: Lists the logpoints in a [Live Debugger](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/live_debugger.md) session, with the service, source location, message template, and enabled state for each.

list_datadog_skills.description: Lists available Datadog skill guides with optional topic search and summaries.

list_datadog_workflow_instances.description: Lists a workflow's execution history, with filters for execution status.

list_datadog_workflows.description: Lists and searches [Workflow Automation](https://docs.datadoghq.com/actions/workflows.md) workflows by name, creator, handle, tag, or trigger type.

list_experiment_segmentation_properties.description: Lists the assignment properties an experiment can be split by.

list_experiments.description: Lists experiments for the organization, with optional name search, limit, and offset for pagination.

list_governance_best_practices.description: Lists recommended governance best practices, each with a description, expected impact, priority, and a link to the relevant page in Datadog.

list_governance_controls.description: Lists the governance [controls](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/governance_console/controls.md) for your organization, including each control's detection type, severity, category, detection counts, and mitigation options.

list_governance_detections.description: Lists the detections for a governance control.

list_governance_insights.description: Retrieves governance health insights for your organization, such as the number of unused API keys or the percentage of monitors with team tags.

list_governance_limits.description: Lists your organization's rate limits and resource limits, with current usage compared to each limit.

list_observability_pipelines.description: Lists all pipelines in your organization, including drafts, with each pipeline's ID, name, type, and creation and modification timestamps.

list_reference_table_rows.description: *Toolset: **reference-tables*** Lists all rows in a reference table with optional filtering and pagination.

list_reference_tables.description: *Toolset: **reference-tables*** Lists and searches [Reference Tables](https://docs.datadoghq.com/reference_tables.md) in the organization, with optional filtering by name and sorting.

load_datadog_skill.description: Reads a Datadog skill guide or its explicitly requested bundled resource.

optimize_datadog_database_query.description: Analyzes a PostgreSQL query for optimization opportunities using deterministic rules.

rank_data_entities_by_lineage_degree.description: Ranks entities by transitive lineage connectivity (upstream, downstream, or both), using a pre-built snapshot.

rank_data_observability_monitor_candidat.description: Ranks tables by monitoring priority, combining lineage impact and query activity into a single composite score.

run_product_analytics_journey.description: Runs funnel, timeseries, scalar, list, and drop-off queries across a multi-step user journey, tracked at the user, session, or account level.

run_product_analytics_pathway.description: Runs a Sankey (pathway) analysis showing how users navigate between views, starting from a source view or leading to a target view.

run_product_analytics_retention.description: Runs retention queries on Product Analytics data as a cohort grid, retention curve, timeseries, or scalar value, tracked at the user or account level.

search_apm_sampling_rules.description: Lists remote sampling rules that set a fixed sample rate for spans matching a service, environment, and resource.

search_apm_service_remapping_rules.description: Lists the organization's service remapping rules in evaluation order, or retrieves one rule by ID.

search_audit_events.description: Searches for Audit Trail events using Datadog query syntax with support for pagination.

search_data_entities.description: Searches for data entities in the data catalog by name, full-text search, or filters (platform, schema, database, account).

search_datadog_cases.description: Searches [Work Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/service_management/case_management.md) work items (cases) with filters including status, priority, project, and assignee.

search_datadog_ci_pipeline_events.description: Searches CI events with filters and returns details on them.

search_datadog_dashboards.description: Lists available Datadog dashboards and key details.

search_datadog_database_plans.description: Searches [Database Monitoring](https://docs.datadoghq.com/database_monitoring.md) query execution plans, which show how the database engine executes queries, including index usage, join strategies, and cost estimates.

search_datadog_database_samples.description: Searches [Database Monitoring](https://docs.datadoghq.com/database_monitoring.md) query samples, which represent individual query executions with performance metrics.

search_datadog_deployment_gate_evaluatio.description: Searches Deployment Gate evaluations by service, environment, or status (`in_progress`, `pass`, or `fail`).

search_datadog_deployment_gate_rule_eval.description: Searches individual rule results across Deployment Gate evaluations.

search_datadog_deployment_gates.description: Searches configured Deployment Gates by service or environment.

search_datadog_entities.description: Searches Datadog's Catalog for service identity, ownership and upstream and downstream dependencies.

search_datadog_error_tracking_issues.description: Searches Error Tracking Issues across data sources (RUM, Logs, Traces).

search_datadog_events.description: Searches events like monitor alerts, deployment notifications, infrastructure changes, security findings, and service status changes.

search_datadog_forms.description: Lists forms visible to your organization, with keyword filtering and pagination.

search_datadog_hosts.description: Lists and provides information about monitored hosts, supporting filtering and searching.

search_datadog_incidents.description: Retrieves a list of Datadog incidents, including their state, severity, and metadata.

search_datadog_k8s_resources.description: Searches for [Kubernetes](https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/monitoring/kubernetes_explorer.md) resources across all clusters.

search_datadog_logs.description: Searches logs with filters (time, query, service, host, storage tier, and so on) and returns log details.

search_datadog_metrics.description: Lists available metrics, with options for filtering and metadata.

search_datadog_monitor_groups.description: Searches monitor groups by name or criteria.

search_datadog_monitors.description: Retrieves information about Datadog monitors, including their statuses, thresholds, and alert conditions.

search_datadog_notebooks.description: Lists and searches Datadog notebooks with filtering by author, tags, and content.

search_datadog_rum_events.description: Search Datadog RUM events using advanced query syntax.

search_datadog_sdk.description: Looks up the SDK functions, types, and API methods available for writing `execute_code` scripts.

search_datadog_security_findings.description: Fallback tool for retrieving full security finding details.

search_datadog_security_ioc_indicators.description: List [IoC Explorer](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/triage_and_investigate/ioc_explorer.md) indicators (IPs, domains, URLs, file hashes) matched against threat intel feeds.

search_datadog_security_signals.description: Searches and retrieves security signals from Datadog Security Monitoring, including Cloud SIEM signals, App & API Protection signals, and Workload Protection signals.

search_datadog_slos.description: Searches Datadog SLOs by name, tags, or type.

search_datadog_spans.description: Retrieves spans from APM traces with filters such as service, time, resource, and so on.

search_datadog_spreadsheets.description: Searches Datadog spreadsheets by name or owner.

search_datadog_test_events.description: Searches [Test Optimization](https://docs.datadoghq.com/tests.md) test events with filters and returns details on them.

search_datadog_users.description: Searches for Datadog users by email, name, or handle.

search_datadog_widgets.description: Searches and retrieves information about widgets across Datadog dashboards, including their IDs, titles, and underlying queries.

search_datadog_workflow_actions.description: Searches the Workflow Automation action catalog with a free-text query and ranks matching actions by relevance.

search_dora_deployments.description: Searches DORA deployment events with filters, or fetches full details for a single deployment by ID.

search_investigations.description: Searches Bits AI investigations by keyword or query.

search_ndm_devices.description: Searches network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) monitored by Datadog [Network Device Monitoring](https://docs.datadoghq.com/network_monitoring/devices.md).

search_ndm_interfaces.description: Retrieves all network interfaces for a specific device.

search_product_analytics_events.description: Finds Product Analytics views and actions matching a natural-language description using semantic search, including org-curated labeled actions.

search_product_analytics_org_entities.description: Looks up org-specific Product Analytics entities by name or keyword (feature flags, context attribute keys, saved charts, and segments).

search_replays.description: Searches Session Replay recordings and returns matching sessions.

search_rum_applications.description: Lists your RUM applications and resolves the `application_id` to use for subsequent RUM tool calls.

search_rum_metrics.description: Explores RUM metrics for an application, including out-of-the-box metrics and custom metrics.

search_rum_operations.description: Lists the [operations](https://docs.datadoghq.com/real_user_monitoring/operations_monitoring.md) in your organization, including both SDK-instrumented and UI-configured operations, and resolves an operation name to its `operation_id` and `application_id`.

search_rum_retention_filters.description: Lists retention filters configured on a RUM application.

search_watchdog_insights.description: Searches Watchdog insights for a product context and time range, including anomalies, outliers, recommendations, and correlations.

search_watchdog_stories.description: Searches Watchdog stories for anomalies and root cause analyses across APM, infrastructure, and logs.

suggest_data_observability_monitor_filte.description: Analyzes a set of entities to find common attributes and naming patterns, and suggests monitor filter expressions that group subsets of those entities.

summarize_data_entity_lineage.description: Returns aggregate lineage statistics (node/edge counts, type breakdowns, depth distribution) for a large or unknown lineage graph, without the full payload.

validate_dashboard_widget.description: Validates a widget definition against the dashboard schema.

validate_datadog_monitor.description: Validates a monitor definition for correctness before creating or updating it.

validate_datadog_workflow.description: Checks a complete workflow specification without creating or modifying a workflow.

validate_notebook_cell.description: Validates notebook cell widget definitions, including SQL correctness for analysis_sql cells.

validate_notebook_cells.description: Validates multiple notebook cell widget definitions in a single call, including SQL correctness for analysis_sql cells.

validate_observability_pipeline.description: Validates a pipeline configuration in the [Observability Pipelines API](https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/observability-pipelines.md) format without creating or deploying anything.

verify_widget_data.description: Verifies whether widget definitions return data for the last hour.
